message.content:
The cover of "TEMPO" magazine features two children in a dense, crowded setting. A girl with dark, tangled hair is crying, her mouth wide open. She wears a pink patterned top and holds a dark, worn metal cooking pot. Beside her, a boy with short dark hair and an open mouth looks toward the viewer. Both children are surrounded by other figures, visible only through arms and clothing.

The large white text "TEMPO" is centered at the top. Above it, "Wawancara Eksklusif Francesca Albanese H.48" and "Zat Radioaktif di Produk Udang Kita H.98" appear on a red and dark background. Large white text in the lower left reads "DUA TAHUN GENOSIDA PALESTINA." Below this, a smaller block of text begins with "Serangan Israel tak hanya membunuh..." and ends with "H.32." 

In the lower right corner, details include "6-12 OKTOBER 2025," "RP 60.000," and a barcode with the number "00034." The lighting is dramatic, casting deep shadows on the figures and highlighting steam rising from another metal pot in the foreground.
